$ corvex --help

--- stdout ---
Corvex orchestrates AI agents to execute complex software development tasks autonomously.

Usage:
  corvex [command]

Available Commands:
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  doctor      Check the config and local environment for common misconfigurations
  grill       Interview to resolve ambiguities in a project spec before planning
  help        Help about any command
  init        Initialize a Corvex project
  inspect     Show per-task timeline, duration, retries, cost from the activity ledger
  list        List available projects
  logs        Show task details and completion info
  plan        Generate or update tasks.md from a project spec
  recipe      Compile a declarative workflow recipe into a runnable task DAG
  reset       Reset a task to PENDING status
  review      List pending escalations awaiting human review
  run         Execute pending tasks for a project
  start       Single entry point for a new feature (brainstorm → grill → plan)
  status      Show DAG status and progress
  validate    Run integration validation against the live stack
  version     Print the corvex version

Flags:
  -h, --help       help for corvex
      --no-color   Disable color output
  -q, --quiet      Suppress per-task progress; print only failures/errors and the final summary
  -v, --version    version for corvex

Use "corvex [command] --help" for more information about a command.

--- stderr ---
(empty)
